blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Coach Yeng Guiao offered no excuses for the way Rain or Shine played poorly in its 129-111 loss to Barangay Ginebra as it resumed its PBA Governors’ Cup campaign on Friday. The Elasto Painters never got it going after the Gin Kings stormed to a big lead and were left to ponder what went wrong as their four-game winning streak was snapped before a big crowd at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. “They just shot the ball too well. The three-point shooting and the four-point shooting were too good. We started out badly,” Guiao said when he emerged from the dugout after […]...
